records.title: Protection of ancient cultures
details:
Hon'ble Minister inter-alia stated as under:-
Respected Chairman, I don't have specific information about it right now, but all the things that have come out of Sinauli have been kept at the Indian Institute of Heritage which is being built in Greater Noida and work is going on. I do not have the specific information about its exact status, I will definitely provide it to you later. This venue is one of our newest finds. This place is one of the five new places found. Documentation and research has started on this some time ago.
(Original in hindi)
